title: Explain endpoint SQL capture is a global, un-thread-filtered log appender - returns another concurrent user's SQL

criteria.given: a SqlCaptureProbe is open for one cell explain while another thread (another user's query) logs SQL on mondrian.sql
criteria.then: the probe's appender only accepts an event its scope claims for the explaining execution; a statement from another thread or execution is never added to the captured list

criteria.given: Mondrian logs the cell's SQL from its own worker threads (shepherd and segment-load pools)
criteria.then: CellExplainService scopes the probe to the olap4j statement it runs, matching the Mondrian execution (Locus) active on the logging thread, so the explaining user's own SQL is still captured

criteria.given: the regression tests for the fix
criteria.then: SqlCaptureProbeTest covers a foreign-thread statement being ignored and two interleaved probes not cross-feeding

criteria.given: AGENTS.md describes the explain SQL probe
criteria.then: it says log4j2 appender, not java.util.logging
